fonts.notes: Placeholder fonts copied from brands/_defaults/fonts (Inter-family: headline ExtraBold, body Regular/Bold). Replace the .ttf files with the brand's licensed fonts and keep the family names. Headlines: tight line-height ~1.0, sentence case. Never use other font families.

colourways.on-photo-or-busy: use the pill: light pill with black logo, or dark pill with white logo

logo.clearSpace: Keep clear space of at least the logo's cap height on all sides; nothing overlaps the logo.
logo.placement: Bottom-left or bottom-right corner, aligned to the content margin. Exactly one logo per design.

card.notes: Headline + CTA usually sit inside a rounded content card (#FFFFFF) on a #FF7563 or #116B71 background with a brand shape behind it.

cta.notes: Short imperative copy: 'Get started', 'Find out more', 'Try Crux for free'.

recipes: A) Card on shape — background #FF7563 (or #116B71). One big brand shape (#116B71 on #FF7563 / #0E8C8C or #FF7563 on #116B71) partially off-canvas (e.g. x=-0.15W, y=-0.1H, width=0.9W). #FFFFFF card x=0.07W y=0.08H width=0.86W with children [headline, (subhead), cta]. Lower half: photo or illustration or product-ui (width 0.6–0.8W) anchored bottom, below the card. Logo (dark variant) width 0.2W bottom-right (or bottom-left) at margin 0.06S; optional 1 charm (0.09W) overlapping the card corner.

B) Headline on dark — background #116B71. stack x=0.06W y=0.08H width=0.88W with children [headline #FFFFFF 0.08S, cta bg #FF7563 color #116B71]. #FF7563 shape bottom-right partially off canvas behind an illustration (width 0.7W) in the lower half. Logo (light variant) bottom-left width 0.2W.
C) Light statement — background #FF7563, #116B71 shape at bottom; #FFFFFF card [headline, subhead, cta]; product-ui device shot overlapping the card bottom edge; logo (dark variant) bottom-right.
D) Stat — background #116B71; stack [stat text e.g. "93%" #FFFFFF, headline #FFFFFF 0.06S, legal]; #FF7563 shape; logo (light variant).

E) Photo hero — generate a photo (purpose photo, 1024x1536 for portrait) filling the lower 55–60%: photo x=0, width=W, y≈0.42H, height=H-y (photos are cover-cropped, faces kept); card with headline+cta in the top 40%; #116B71 shape peeking from a corner; logo with pill if it sits over the photo.

9:16.note: Meta Stories/Reels: keep text, CTA and logo out of the top 14% and bottom 35%.

voice.tone: Confident, warm, plain-spoken. Short punchy sentences. Sentence case.
headlinePatterns: Two short sentences: 'Data in. Doubt out.'
Outcome: 'Up and running in under an hour.'
Contrast: 'Run your business, not your paperwork.'

imagery.shapes: Use one large brand shape partially cropped off the canvas edge behind the card or photo. Never recolour outside the palette.
imagery.illustrations: Use on #116B71 or #FF7563 backgrounds, never over photos.
imagery.charms: Use 1–2 small icons as accents near the card edge or photo; keep small (≤12% of canvas width).
imagery.photos: Real people, warm natural light, candid. Place in the lower half under the card.
imagery.productUI: Device/screen shots — use when the message is about the product itself.

rules: Use only brand palette colours for backgrounds, text, shapes and CTAs.
Headlines in CruxHeadline; body and CTA text in CruxBody/CruxBodyBold.
Exactly one Crux logo per design, at least 14% of canvas width, in a corner with clear space.
Dark logo on light backgrounds; light logo on dark backgrounds; use a pill over photos.
Headline ≤ 60 characters, sentence case, no exclamation marks.
Text contrast must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1).
Respect platform safe zones (Meta 9:16: top 14%, bottom 35%).
Keep all text and the logo at least 5% away from canvas edges.
Shapes and photos may bleed off the canvas; text, logo and CTA may not.

imageStyles.illustration: Flat vector illustration in the Crux brand style: bold simple shapes, one sweeping ribbon-like shape in #FF7563 and #0E8C8C, small playful objects, soft 3D-ish shading, clean edges, optimistic mood. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or logos. Isolated subject on a fully transparent background.
imageStyles.photo: Editorial photograph of a real person at work, candid, warm natural light, shallow depth of field, authentic and optimistic, modern workspace. No text or logos anywhere.
imageStyles.background: Abstract minimal background made of smooth organic shapes in #0E8C8C on #FF7563, flat vector, no gradients, no text, large soft curves that bleed off the edges.
imageStyles.charm: Small glossy 3D icon in the Crux brand style: #FF7563 and #0E8C8C with a small #116B71 detail, simple, playful, soft shading. No text. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
